About this item

  • THE MULTI-LAYER INSULATION TECHNOLOGY FEATURES: the first layer is a thick food-grade 18/8 stainless steel inner wall; the second layer has a copper plating that reduces heat transfer; the third layer is a vacuum layer that prevents heat loss. As a result, you can enjoy an insulated water bottle that keeps beverages cold for up to 48 hours and hot for up to 24 hours, making it perfect for any adventure, whether it's a long hike or a busy workday.
  • VERSATILE AND STYLISH CARRIER BAG：The colorful water bottle carrier bag is designed to match the bottle's body, adding a touch of flair while providing practical functionality. The shoulder strap and carabiner make it easy to carry and hang, whether you're out on a hike or running errands. Plus, the small storage bag for your phone and a hook for keys make this bottle even more versatile.
  • OUTDOOR-READY PRACTICAL DESIGN：Whether you're hiking, camping, or traveling, this water bottle is built for outdoor durability. The braided handle rope with fishbone weaving is not only sturdy and thick but feels great to hold, providing a comfortable grip. Plus, the included compass ensures you're always on track in the great outdoors.
  • SCRATCH-RESISTANT AND BUILT TO LAST：Featuring a high-quality plastic powder coating on the outer surface, this thermo flask is scratch-resistant and extremely durable, making it perfect for both indoor and outdoor use. Whether you're at the gym, on a trail, or sitting at your desk, this sleek and sturdy bottle will maintain its pristine look, no matter the environment. Its resilient coating means it stands up to daily wear and tear, ensuring it lasts through countless adventures.
  • CONVENIENT ACCESSORIES FOR EASY CLEANING AND USE：Say goodbye to cleaning hassles! This bottle comes with replacement straws, straw brush, and bottle brush to ensure your bottle stays spotless, no matter how often you use it. The wide-mouth design makes it easy to clean, and it’s also perfect for adding ice cubes for a refreshing cold drink. With these thoughtful accessories, keeping your bottle clean and ready for your next adventure is as simple as it gets.

Customers say

Customers love this water bottle's size, noting it's perfect for all-day drinking and holds about a half gallon, while appreciating its temperature retention that keeps water cold all day. They find it worth the value, with one customer mentioning it saves money by reducing plastic bottle purchases, and appreciate its portability with multiple carrying options, including a convenient handle. The bottle's durability and leak-proof performance receive mixed feedback - while some say it holds up well with little denting, others report issues with the handle and lid breaking quickly, and while some say it doesn't leak at all, others mention leakage problems.

Amazon Customer
5 out of 5 stars
Good insulation, cool colors & nice carry bag.
I've had this for one day & I already love it. On a 108 degree day, I filled this to the top with ice & never needed to add more. By the end of a 10 hr shift, there was still enough ice filling at least a quarter of the bottle. The bottle itself seems pretty durable. The option of lids is nice but I don't have any use for straws so I stick with the flip top that screws down so it won't accidentally open. Color scheme looks good too. The carry bag is nice too, giving you 4 ways to carry it as well as one extra layer of insulation. And if you just want the bottle without anything on it, all accessories are removable. Although a little effort might be needed to put them back around the neck. We'll see how well everything holds up over time but I'm really happy with this purchase.

    I've had this for one day & I already love it. On a 108 degree day, I filled this to the top with ice & never needed to add more. By the end of a 10 hr shift, there was still enough ice filling at least a quarter of the bottle. The bottle itself seems pretty durable. The option of lids is nice but I don't have any use for straws so I stick with the flip top that screws down so it won't accidentally open. Color scheme looks good too. The carry bag is nice too, giving you 4 ways to carry it as well as one extra layer of insulation. And if you just want the bottle without anything on it, all accessories are removable. Although a little effort might be needed to put them back around the neck. We'll see how well everything holds up over time but I'm really happy with this purchase.

    5 out of 5 stars
    Missing item (Solved!)

    Color: VerdantSize: 128 Ounces

    Brief content visible, double tap to read full content.

    I love my bottle! The colour and quality is amazing! Seems easy to clean as well.

    The problem? I'm missing the straws, which is kind of a dealbreaker since I only drink from that type of mouth, the other one is useless to me. It also didn't come with the straw or bottle cleaners, that bothers me less since I have some already.

    I'd really like to not return this and somehow just get the missing items (Mostly the straws.)

    ---

    Review of actual product:

    Gosh darn is this thing HEAVY! I wasn't expecting it. But the quantity lasts me 12 hours just fine. I'm considering the extra weight an excuse to get a workout for my arms, haha, but if you have any type of disability, you might want to consider a smaller size. My stronger and taller friend uses their gifted bottle just fine, they also say they really like it.

    This one (128oz) doesn't fit in my backpack, which is a shame, but oh well. It can also be a struggle to fill it all the way, depending on what you get your water from. I can do it to the top, my friend can only get 8/10ths unless he wants to use a separate cup to scoop the rest of the water in.

    The colour is beautiful, the clips and bands seem sturdy, I got a stain on the sleeve, and it washed out with just a dab of water. The mouth is wide enough to pour ice in, and it keeps the same temperature forever!

    ---

    Edit: The seller contacted me quickly and helped me find a solution, they were very concise and answered all of my questions. I will say, there seems to be a problem with quality control, I think sometimes bottles get sent back, and they can miss any damages/missing items because of that.

    I bought another bottle and this one had a black smudge on the sleeve I couldn't wash out, it's not a dealbreaker for me, but so far 2 of the 3 bottles had some error. The only reason I'm keeping it at five stars despite that is because of their customer service being 10/10 and the quality of the product being the same.

About this Item

  • THE MULTI-LAYER INSULATION TECHNOLOGY FEATURES: the first layer is a thick food-grade 18/8 stainless steel inner wall; the second layer has a copper plating that reduces heat transfer; the third layer is a vacuum layer that prevents heat loss. As a result, you can enjoy an insulated water bottle that keeps beverages cold for up to 48 hours and hot for up to 24 hours, making it perfect for any adventure, whether it's a long hike or a busy workday.
  • VERSATILE AND STYLISH CARRIER BAG：The colorful water bottle carrier bag is designed to match the bottle's body, adding a touch of flair while providing practical functionality. The shoulder strap and carabiner make it easy to carry and hang, whether you're out on a hike or running errands. Plus, the small storage bag for your phone and a hook for keys make this bottle even more versatile.
  • OUTDOOR-READY PRACTICAL DESIGN：Whether you're hiking, camping, or traveling, this water bottle is built for outdoor durability. The braided handle rope with fishbone weaving is not only sturdy and thick but feels great to hold, providing a comfortable grip. Plus, the included compass ensures you're always on track in the great outdoors.
  • SCRATCH-RESISTANT AND BUILT TO LAST：Featuring a high-quality plastic powder coating on the outer surface, this thermo flask is scratch-resistant and extremely durable, making it perfect for both indoor and outdoor use. Whether you're at the gym, on a trail, or sitting at your desk, this sleek and sturdy bottle will maintain its pristine look, no matter the environment. Its resilient coating means it stands up to daily wear and tear, ensuring it lasts through countless adventures.
  • CONVENIENT ACCESSORIES FOR EASY CLEANING AND USE：Say goodbye to cleaning hassles! This bottle comes with replacement straws, straw brush, and bottle brush to ensure your bottle stays spotless, no matter how often you use it. The wide-mouth design makes it easy to clean, and it’s also perfect for adding ice cubes for a refreshing cold drink. With these thoughtful accessories, keeping your bottle clean and ready for your next adventure is as simple as it gets.
